dedupe_keys.name: second generation component and system level seismic fragility models for reinforced concrete bridges in california

description: Second-Generation Component and System-Level Seismic Fragility Models for Reinforced Concrete Bridges in California is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Yazhou Xie, University of California Los Angeles (ucla.edu). California is a seismically active region that contains approximately 26,000 bridges. Historical earthquakes have caused severe damage and collapse of bridges in California, resulting in casualties, economic losses, and disruptions to transportation networks. Seismic fragility models of bridges estimate the probability of exceeding damage states at varying ground motion intensity levels. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (CSV, TXT). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-c73m-nj37. Keywords: Reinforced concrete bridges, California, Component and system-level fragilities, Seismic hazards, Risk and resilience. Published 2025-04-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
